format: JavaScript (ES6 module with LightningJS component syntax)
description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'NotesList', which renders a list of notes with search, create, and delete functionalities. It manages internal state such as dimensions, styles, and selected item index, and exposes methods for interacting with the list, including filtering and selecting items.

methods.name: $relativeTime
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a relative time string, such as '5m ago' or '2d ago'.

methods.name: $moveDown
methods.description: Moves the selection index down by one within the filtered list, updating the selected item.

methods.name: $moveUp
methods.description: Moves the selection index up by one within the filtered list, updating the selected item.

methods.name: $selectItem
methods.description: Selects the currently highlighted item in the list.

methods.name: $handleCreate
methods.description: Triggers the create note action and resets the internal index.
